examples.en: Everyone was dressed like a clown.

examples.text: Mi amigo verdaderamente es un payaso.
examples.en: My friend is really a clown.
The clown went back to the circus.

examples.text: El payaso hizo una mueca graciosa.
examples.en: The clown made a funny face.

examples.text: El grupo de payasos comenzó a tropezar mientras corrían.
examples.en: The group of clowns began stumbling as they ran.
